title: Unbound Recursive — stats-only snapshot
description: Operator-exported stats_noreset snapshots, no administrative socket access.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "unbound_snapshot" and r.service == "unbound-recursive" and (r._field == "total_num_queries"))
  |> derivative(unit: 1s, nonNegative: true, initialZero: false)
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)

from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "unbound_snapshot" and r.service == "unbound-recursive" and (r._field == "total_num_cachehits"))
  |> derivative(unit: 1s, nonNegative: true, initialZero: false)
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)

from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "unbound_snapshot" and r.service == "unbound-recursive" and (r._field == "total_num_cachemiss"))
  |> derivative(unit: 1s, nonNegative: true, initialZero: false)
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)

from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "unbound_snapshot" and r.service == "unbound-recursive" and (r._field == "total_recursion_time_avg"))
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: last, createEmpty: false)

from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "unbound_snapshot" and r.service == "unbound-recursive" and (r._field == "num_answer_rcode_SERVFAIL"))
  |> derivative(unit: 1s, nonNegative: true, initialZero: false)
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)

from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "unbound_snapshot" and r.service == "unbound-recursive" and (r._field == "num_answer_rcode_NXDOMAIN"))
  |> derivative(unit: 1s, nonNegative: true, initialZero: false)
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)

from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "unbound_snapshot" and r.service == "unbound-recursive" and (r._field == "num_query_type_A" or r._field == "num_query_type_AAAA" or r._field == "num_query_type_TXT" or r._field == "num_query_type_PTR" or r._field == "num_query_type_HTTPS" or r._field == "num_query_type_MX"))
  |> derivative(unit: 1s, nonNegative: true, initialZero: false)
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)

from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "unbound_snapshot" and r.service == "unbound-recursive" and (r._field == "total_num_queries_ip_ratelimited"))
  |> derivative(unit: 1s, nonNegative: true, initialZero: false)
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)

from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "unbound_snapshot" and r.service == "unbound-recursive" and (r._field == "mem_cache_rrset" or r._field == "mem_cache_message"))
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: last, createEmpty: false)

from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "unbound_snapshot" and r.service == "unbound-recursive" and (r._field == "num_query_tcp"))
  |> derivative(unit: 1s, nonNegative: true, initialZero: false)
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)

from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "unbound_snapshot" and r.service == "unbound-recursive" and (r._field == "total_num_cachehits" or r._field == "total_num_cachemiss" or r._field == "time_up"))
  |> pivot(rowKey: ["_time"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value")
  |> difference(columns: ["total_num_cachehits", "total_num_cachemiss", "time_up"], nonNegative: true)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => exists r.time_up and r.time_up > 0.0 and exists r.total_num_cachehits and exists r.total_num_cachemiss and r.total_num_cachehits + r.total_num_cachemiss > 0.0)
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with _value: 100.0 * r.total_num_cachehits / (r.total_num_cachehits + r.total_num_cachemiss), _field: "cache_hit_percent"}))
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)

from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: -10m)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "unbound_snapshot" and r.service == "unbound-recursive" and r._field == "total_num_queries")
  |> group(columns: ["host"])
  |> last()
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with _value: float(v: int(v: now()) - int(v: r._time)) / 1000000000.0}))

from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "unbound_snapshot" and r.service == "unbound-recursive" and (r._field == "num_answer_rcode_NOERROR" or r._field == "num_answer_rcode_SERVFAIL" or r._field == "num_answer_rcode_NXDOMAIN" or r._field == "num_answer_rcode_REFUSED"))
  |> derivative(unit: 1s, nonNegative: true, initialZero: false)
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)
